he just kind of like — what’s the word I’m looking for when you want to like sanctify a space before you do a deep piece or something you know. Go to the four corners and things like that. This woman, a great composer, she teaches — no she just retired — up at Poughkeepsie, oh I’m spacing, at a girl’s school there, a woman’s school. It’s a good school.
